command_timeout_acceptance.semantics: sync run/connect ignore request_timeout; async applies it to first-event waiting. Negative timeout becomes 1 ms; an over-ten-digit Connect millisecond header is rejected. wait inherits its stream deadline. Start also sets the process execution deadline: late connect returns retained exit -1/signal: killed. Connect-only deadline leaves the original process live, allowing same-PID EOF and full success.
